examples.text:
Cada día alguien me habla de ti
intentando sacar el dolor de mi alma
Cada día alguien me habla de ti
intentando explicarme que ya no volverás
examples.english:
Every day someone speaks of you to me,
trying to quell the pain in my soul
Every day someone speaks of you to me,
trying to explain to me that you aren't coming back

examples.text: Si me dieran 1 peso por cada que vea a alguien decir que es Spiderman, tendría 5 pesos.
examples.translation: If I had 1 peso for every time I've seen someone say they're Spiderman, I'd have 5 pesos.
